title: What to watch out for at the 2026 Cannes Film Festival
summary: A total of 22 films are competing for the Palme d'Or this year as the presitigious Cannes Film Festival begins in the south of France on Tuesday. The nine-person jury this year will be headed by South Korean director Park Chan-Wook but will also feature US celebrity Demi Moore, star of "The Substance".
